hooks.command: p=$(cat); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; printf '%s' "$p" | grep -qE 'tests/test_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\.py' && python3 scripts/gen_test_niva.py >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '%s' "$p" | grep -qE 'tests/suites/[A-Za-z0-9_]+_suite[A-Za-z0-9_]*\.niva' && python3 scripts/gen_run_niva.py >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
